notes:
Account summary: BranchLore is building an IDE-integrated copilot that uses repo-aware context retrieval. Primary drivers: developer productivity + IP protection. They have an internal monorepo (~20M LOC) and want embeddings + vector DB to power local code search and context for completions. Key asks: 
- Low-latency streaming for in-IDE completions (p50 target <40ms, p95 <80ms).
- Model/version pinning for deterministic assistants (devs require reproducible completions across releases).
- Chunking strategy: prefer repo-aware chunk boundaries (function + comment-aware) instead of fixed-size chunks.
- Vector DB residency: EU-only, audit trail for index updates, and ability to schedule redaction/purge.
- Security: SSO (SAML), KMS integrations for keys, SOC2/ISO questions in review.
- Cost sensitivity: will accept higher unit costs for Dedicated if latency and residency guarantees meet SLOs; long-term optimize for unit cost via quantization + caching.
Recent quote from CTO: "We won't ship the copilot with our IP unless the embeddings and KV caches never leave EU jurisdiction."
POC notes: 
- Tech spike performed to measure prefix caching benefits; best-case token savings ~35% on recurrent prompts.
- Evaluated two vector DBs: one managed with EU tenancy, one self-hosted option (customer leaning to self-hosted inside VPC).
- SE comment (Rafael): need to show per-route cost breakdown and token-level latency profile in Console for their SREs to sign off.
Next steps (short): finalize POC SOW, procurement asks for indemnity clause for code indexing, schedule Dedicated capacity test week starting 2026-03-18.
Potential risks: legal negotiations over code indexing/retention could push to procurement or kill the deal if not resolved quickly.
